headline: Joe Mama Angie Daddy Wins Despite Benching a 43.8-Point Joe Burrow, Stays Alone Atop Standings at 6-1
meme_brief: A guy benches his own quarterback, the backup still wins him the game, and he walks away looking like a genius instead of the guy who sat a 43-point performance on his own bench.
recap: Joe Mama Angie Daddy moved to 6-1 with a 146.9-108.35 win over Pukachu Chews You, but the real story on that roster was self-inflicted: Joe Burrow sat on the bench and dropped 43.8 points while Brock Purdy started and managed 19.9, a 23.9-point gap that would have been the week's headline if the team had actually lost. It didn't, because Tee Higgins, Javonte Williams and Rhamondre Stevenson all turned in 20-plus-point days anyway. Chuba Bucky Doo put up the week's highest team score, 150.45, in a 42.1-point rout of Screaming Eagles, getting 29.35 from Kirk Cousins and 27.8 from Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
transaction_desk: Dak to the Future's blowout win over Silverbacks, 133.6-85.3, was set up by Dak Prescott's 34.4 points, and the margin ballooned further because Silverbacks left Michael Penix on the bench for 31.55 points while starting Aaron Rodgers for 18.2, an 13.35-point mistake in what was already a 48.3-point loss. Pukachu Chews You's loss to Joe Mama Angie Daddy had a similar flavor: Omar Cooper scored 21.0 unused on the bench while Jordan Mason started and got 6.8, a 14.2-point gap in a game decided by only 9.5.

standings_narrative: The three division leaders hold the top three playoff seeds as things stand: Joe Mama Angie Daddy out of the Diamonds at 6-1, Chuba Bucky Doo out of the Hearts at 5-2, and Broke Dak Mountain out of the Clubs at 4-3. Dak to the Future and Meredith's Fan Club, both from the Diamonds, slot into seeds four and five on the next-best records at 5-2 and 4-3. The sixth and final spot currently belongs to mikelanta on total season points (872.9) despite a 3-4 record, edging out Pukachu Chews You, who sits right behind at 851.9 points and would take the spot if the points race flips. Screaming Eagles, Long Live King Henry, demon44, Silverbacks and Waffle House are all on the outside looking in.
look_ahead: Week 8 features Chuba Bucky Doo against Dak to the Future, a matchup of two teams coming off wins with real offensive firepower on both sides. Joe Mama Angie Daddy, fresh off surviving its own Joe Burrow benching, draws mikelanta, who is still waiting on last week's flurry of waiver moves to produce anything. Broke Dak Mountain visits Meredith's Fan Club, Waffle House hosts Silverbacks in a game between two teams near the bottom of the standings, Long Live King Henry takes on Pukachu Chews You, and demon44 faces Screaming Eagles in a matchup of two teams sitting outside the playoff picture.

running_jokes: Joe Mama Angie Daddy's bench decisions are becoming a pattern worth watching — this week it was a 43.8-point Joe Burrow sitting behind Brock Purdy, and the team won anyway.
mikelanta ran five transactions in a single week for the second straight tracked week and still hasn't gotten production from the new additions.
Pukachu Chews You and demon44 both posted bench mistakes with real margins again, continuing a stretch of costly lineup calls across multiple rosters.
Kirk Cousins remains the standard-bearer for cheap bench-the-field pickups, now sitting at 144.1 cumulative points since being added for no priority cost.
